title: Recipe 68 — Retrieval-augmented agents with knowledge and memory

beats.label: Open the recipe
beats.cue: “Two different things people both call RAG: knowledge you curated, and memory the agent accumulated.”

beats.label: Start from a blank spec
beats.cue: live/ is scratch — nothing committed is touched by a take.

beats.label: Load the API key
beats.cue: [needs-key] Sources demos/.env — embedding a corpus is billed.

groups.title: Beat 1 · knowledge — the corpus you curated

beats.label: Type the docs agent
beats.cue: “A knowledge block naming a real directory. Citations come back with ids, so an answer can be audited.”

beats.label: Lint it
beats.cue: “Clean — retrieval is declared surface, so a reviewer can see exactly what the agent can read.”

beats.label: Compile it
beats.cue: “It compiles. Booting it is a different question — this spec points at a ./docs corpus that only exists in your project.”

verify.note: emits the bundle; --check would stop at the missing local corpus, which is the recipe's own precondition

beats.label: Open the emitted agent
beats.cue: “The retrieve tool is generated. You don't write a chunker, an embedder, or a vector-store client.”

groups.title: Beat 2 · memory — what the agent accumulated

beats.label: Blank the scratch spec
beats.cue: “Now the other half. Same retrieval machinery, different source of truth.”

beats.label: Type the support bot
beats.cue: “A channel bot with memory — it remembers this user, not the manual.”

beats.label: Lint it
beats.cue: “Clean. Memory is a block, not a bolt-on.”

beats.label: Compile it and check it
beats.cue: “--check: GREEN, gated at the declared credentials. Memory needs no local corpus, so this one boots.”

verify.note: GREEN — assertion ok; install ok; boot gated at the declared credentials gate

beats.label: Type the memory config variants
beats.cue: “`memory: {}` takes the defaults. The recipe shows what each knob is actually for before you touch one.”

beats.label: Read it
beats.cue: “Defaults that work are worth more than knobs you have to learn.”

beats.label: Diff the two bundles
beats.cue: “knowledge.embedder → memory.embedder: the same component, wired to two different stores.”
beats.command: diff live/docs/agent.ts live/mem/gateway.ts > live/rag.diff; test -s live/rag.diff

verify.note: the two RAG shapes emit different programs from shared machinery

beats.label: Read the delta
beats.cue: “Curated knowledge and accumulated memory are different problems. Sharing an embedder doesn't make them the same one.”

groups.title: One more thing · ask it something cited

beats.label: Run the docs agent
beats.cue: [needs-key] “Point it at a real corpus first — the recipe's ./docs. Then ask something only the docs know.”

verify.note: needs a local corpus to index and a model credential

beats.label: Ask a corpus question
beats.cue: [needs-key] “The answer comes back with [1] id=manual.md#4 — a citation you can go read.”
beats.text: What does the manual say about refund windows?
